context: Tests whether the agent correctly classifies CI failures using provided run data: identifying pre-existing failures (fail on other branches), PR-introduced failures (pass on other branches), and unverified failures (no other-branch data). Also tests that the agent uses the correct summary table format, performs root-cause analysis by comparing the diff against error output, and does not make unsupported assumptions about failure causes.

checklist.name: Summary table present
checklist.description: ci-report.md contains a markdown table with at least the 3 failing test names as rows

checklist.name: Our PR column
checklist.description: The summary table includes a column showing the PR run result for each test (e.g. 'Our PR' or similar label showing FAIL)

checklist.name: Run ID columns with branch names
checklist.description: The summary table has separate columns for each reference branch run, with the column headers identifying the run ID and branch name (e.g. 'Run 9000000901 (main)' or similar format pairing a numeric ID with a branch)

checklist.name: Verdict column
checklist.description: The summary table includes a 'Verdict' column (or equivalent) with a classification for each test

checklist.name: test_A: pre-existing verdict
checklist.description: test_A is classified as pre-existing (or flaky, or existing failure) — indicating it fails on other branches and is not caused by this PR

checklist.name: test_B: introduced verdict
checklist.description: test_B is classified as introduced by this PR (or new failure, or regression) — indicating it passes on all other branches but fails on the PR

checklist.name: test_C: unverified verdict
checklist.description: test_C is classified as unverified (or indeterminate, or unknown) — NOT classified as pre-existing or introduced

checklist.name: test_C: no cross-reference explanation
checklist.description: The report explicitly notes that test_C does not appear in any of the other branch run results and therefore cannot be cross-referenced or given a definitive classification

checklist.name: test_B root cause: function rename
checklist.description: The root cause analysis for test_B identifies that the get_cart_total method was renamed to compute_cart_total in the diff, which caused the AttributeError in the test

checklist.name: pr.diff cited as evidence
checklist.description: The root cause section references or quotes the pr.diff (or the specific lines showing the rename) as the evidence for why test_B fails

checklist.name: Suggested fix for test_B
checklist.description: A concrete fix is suggested for test_B (e.g. update the test to call compute_cart_total instead of get_cart_total, or add a compatibility alias)
